{{Top|ca|leg}}
The [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;which possessed two [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]]&mdash;chewed '''pureweed''', [[Leather/Legends|leather]] strips, laced with stimulants, with their lower mouth while speaking with the other positioned above.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Pureweed was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
